messages:
arjun: heads-up — planning a surge-simulation dry run tonight to validate our new batching + kv-cache warmup. target: 10k rps for 20m with ramp and 10m cool-down. anyone opposed?

sam: OK from my side. which cluster and tenant?

arjun: use dedicated-staging-2 in us-west-2, tenant=redwood-test-ops, model=rw-medium-v2 (quantized).

lia: please include the db connection-limit check. last time we hit max_connections on pg-read and started queueing. set DB_CONN_POOL=80 for the run?

arjun: good call. will set env override: `DB_CONN_POOL=80` and enable query sampling.

maria: can infra-bot schedule the run and post links to dashboards + runbook?

infra-bot: scheduled surge-sim dryrun on dedicated-staging-2 at 2023-12-31T02:00:00Z. run id: surge-dryrun-20231231-a. dashboards: https://grafana.internal/r/ops/surge-dryrun-a, runbook: https://wiki.internal/ops/surge-sim-runbook. Notifications: #eng-runtime.

arjun: test plan summary: 1) 5m warmup to populate KV cache; 2) 5m ramp to 10k rps; 3) 20m sustain; 4) 10m cool-down. abort criteria: p50 > 200ms for 5m, error rate > 1% sustained for 2m, or CPU on p99 node > 92%.

sam: do we want to run a small profiler snapshot at peak? I can trigger `perf` + jemalloc stats.

arjun: yes — @sam capture perf + jemalloc at t+12m and t+16m. also capture NVTX traces for batch paths.

lia: token-cache churn metric? add `kv_cache_hit_ratio` alarm if < 65% for > 3m. last reroute caused cache misses.

arjun: added kv_cache_hit_ratio < 65% alarm.

maria: will watchers include SRE oncall? @nate can you join for rollback coordination?

nate: yep, I'll be oncall and reachable. add me to runbook watchers.

sam: load generator config: using k6 with real-traffic replay adapter. snippet:```bash
k6 run --vus 500 --duration 30m --rps 10000 -e TENANT=redwood-test-ops scripts/surge-replay.js
```plan to run multiple k6 agents across 6 boxes.

arjun: good. also enable trace sampling at 0.2% to avoid data blowup.

lia: quick checklist for tomorrow: 1) infra-bot snapshot AMI? 2) user-sessions TTL set to 6h? 3) retention on traces set to 3d for the run.

infra-bot: AMI snapshot taken: ami-0abc1234, timestamp 2023-12-31T00:45:00Z. traces retention set to 3d for run id surge-dryrun-20231231-a.

maria: after run we'll compare to baseline run id 1700123000 (last full soak). prep a diff: p50/p95/p99 and token cost delta per 1k requests.

arjun: will upload perf artifacts and a short notes doc to the run folder: https://storage.internal/runs/surge-dryrun-20231231-a/artifacts.tar.gz

sam: reminder: disable autoscale burst policy so we don't spill into prod capacity accidentally.

lia: handled — autoscale burst off.

nate: I'll be watching DB, infra, and have rollback steps ready. ping me with `@nate rollback` if abort.

arjun: final: start time t=02:00Z, estimated end 02:35Z. if no objections I'll hit go in 20m.

maria: :thumbsup: go from me.

sam: ready.

lia: ready.

nate: oncall ready.

arjun: launching in 18m, posting progress updates to this thread and #eng-runtime.

infra-bot: run surge-dryrun-20231231-a: state=starting, allocs=6 agents. logs: https://logs.internal/surge-dryrun-20231231-a

arjun: (update) warmup complete, kv cache hit ratio ~78%, p50=42ms, error rate=0.02%

sam: started perf capture at t+12m — uploading profiles to artifacts now.

maria: dashboards look healthy. no DB connection saturation. p95 ~ 180ms.

lia: seeing a small spike in 1 node CPU at t+14m (89%). watching.

arjun: sustained phase hit, p50 120ms, p95 220ms, p99 450ms, error rate 0.4% — within abort thresholds. continuing.

sam: second perf snapshot taken t+16m. nvtx shows batching hotpath spike.

arjun: cool-down started. shutting down k6 agents gracefully.

infra-bot: run complete: final p50=75ms, p95=200ms, p99=420ms, errors=0.35%. artifacts uploaded: https://storage.internal/runs/surge-dryrun-20231231-a/artifacts.tar.gz

maria: thanks team — I'll assemble a short post-run notes doc and open a follow-up ticket for batching micro-optimizations.

lia: adding a note to add a small load test to PRs that touch batch code.

arjun: great run. closing thread in 24h unless someone needs follow-up.
